_meta.what: The closed vocabulary for the leaderboard's `actor` field — WHO ran a capture action.
_meta.why: score.py has always validated `marker` against its declared lens and `lens` against the detector set, and `actor` against nothing. 150 published records ran on an open vocabulary, so a typo or a freelance new faction would have shipped silently and split a bar in two. Declared here, enforced in score.py::validate, and read by website/tools/gen-crosstab.py rather than copied into it.
_meta.discipline: Symmetric by construction. The board's whole claim is method-not-ideology, which is falsifiable only if the actor vocabulary can name capture run from any direction — so movement families come in opposed pairs (progressive_left / religious_right, revolutionary_vanguard / hindu_nationalist) and the institutional families are ideologically empty (state, technocratic, commercial_pr, internal_clique). An actor value is a description of who acted, never a verdict on whether they were right.
_meta.adding_one: Add it here with a definition first, then use it. The build fails the other way round, which is the point.

actors.state: A state acting through its own organs — ministries, agencies, regulators, security services.
actors.state_leninist: A Leninist party-state and the transmission belts it runs through unions, fronts and diaspora organisations.
actors.revolutionary_vanguard: A self-appointed vanguard leading a movement it holds incapable of leading itself.
actors.commercial_pr: Commercial public relations, and the industries buying it, operating on a target institution.
actors.technocratic: Expert and standards bodies governing through procedure, delegated rulemaking and definitional control.
actors.trust_safety: Platform trust-and-safety functions and the government or NGO referral channels feeding them.
actors.internal_clique: An unaccountable in-group operating inside an institution it does not own or answer to.
actors.ideological_bloc: An organised ideological coalition operating across several institutions at once.
actors.progressive_left: Movement organisations of the progressive left acting on an institution.
actors.religious_right: Movement organisations of the religious right acting on an institution.
actors.theocratic: A clerical authority exercising state or quasi-state power.
actors.hindu_nationalist: Hindu-nationalist movement organisations and their diaspora arms.
